sections.text: مقدمة

These pumps circulate demi-water in closed 
 cooling system.

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which 
 must be carried out every six month as indicated by M6 in the above title 
 block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Ahmad Shanab and revised by maintenance general 
 manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib تمت الموافقة عليه من قبل 
 المهندس أحمد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء النوبرية و
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 المدير العام ومنسق MPIS المعتمد من قبل المهندس. 
 Mohamed Nagieb 
inspection & quality control head sector
